title: Shape of the unary token split
statement: For every Boolean word $x$, write $(k,y)$ for the length and residual word obtained by removing the longest initial run of true bits. The unary token split of $x$ is the pair whose first component is $k$ true bits followed by the first bit of $y$, if any, and whose second component is $y$ with its first bit removed; moreover, $y$ is empty or begins with false.
replaced:
For every binary string $x$: the unary token splitter returns the leading run of
ones together with at most one following bit as the token, and the rest as the
suffix; moreover the residue after the leading run never starts with another
one.
